recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞密集，除成熟顆粒球外，有多顆大型、染色質細緻的母細胞與早幼粒細胞，並可見嗜酸性骨髓細胞與含深色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球，提示 CML 進展期的母細胞與嗜鹼性球增加。
features: Numerous large immature cells (blasts/promyelocytes) with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Basophils/basophilic precursors with coarse dark purple granules
Maturing myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils; a small dark nucleated red cell
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with granulocytic predominance and a conspicuous immature component, including large blasts and promyelocytes with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. Eosinophilic myelocytes and basophils with coarse dark granules are readily seen, along with maturing neutrophils. A 500-cell differential is needed to document blast (10-19%) and basophil (>=20%) thresholds. In a patient with BCR::ABL1-positive CML, findings are consistent with accelerated phase.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase marrow has <10% blasts and less prominent basophilia, while cell types present are otherwise similar.
Blast phase requires >=20% blasts, and lymphoid blast phase would show TdT+ B- or T-lymphoblasts.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 neoplasms show eosinophilia without BCR::ABL1 and require FISH or molecular testing.
